text:
Liam Park: Heads-up — candidate Mei Chen (SWE II) is AUS-AEST and asked for a short orientation call about benefits and payroll before the interview loop. Also asked if orientation can be recorded.
Harper (Recruiter): She prefers Wed/Thu mornings AEST. Also flagged customs paperwork for the loaner (import declaration). Wants call before device handoff.
Sofia Ramos: We can do a 30m benefits + payroll briefing. Payroll team needs headcount code and candidate's tax residency form. Harper, did we get that?
Harper (Recruiter): Sent tax residency form link 2026-11-02 09:12 AEST; candidate submitted half, needs TFN copy (tax file number). I'll nudge.
Yusuf: Loaner logistics: international shipment to Sydney office hold. Customs note required: commercial invoice marked 'temporary import for interview' + serial numbers. Also need LOA signed before release.
Ava: Panel scheduling note: Panel is mostly PST/EST. AEST (UTC+10) is ahead. If candidate wants morning (09:30 AEST) that's 16:30-17:30 PDT previous day. We should avoid asking engineers to stay too late. Hybrid option: do core interviews live with two interviewers, and one async homework.
Liam Park: Candidate okay with 09:30 AEST on Thu 2026-12-10. Panel volunteers: Yusuf (can do early), Ava (can do until 17:30 PST), Mei (ops) will observe. Need one more interviewer — Harper, any volunteers?
Harper (Recruiter): I'll ask the hiring mgr. Also candidate asked whether orientation recording is ok. We must get consent and store in YubiVault.
Sofia Ramos: Consent required. Add note: "orient-record-consent: signed" before recording. We'll provide a short agenda: benefits overview, payroll schedule (pay dates in AUD), and how to enroll in health plan (links).
PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: international loaners require customs paperwork + LOA before release. Template: https://redwood/internal/loaner/international-template. Processing lead time: 5 business days.
Yusuf: I'll start SHIPMENT-INT-2026-44. ETA to Sydney office hold: 2026-12-04. Need candidate TFN copy and signed LOA to clear customs. Harper, please confirm when TFN received.
Harper (Recruiter): TFN copy received 2026-11-30 14:05 AEST. LOA sent and signed 2026-11-29. Adding notes to candidate file.
Ava: Schedule proposal: Thu 2026-12-10 09:30 AEST / Wed 17:30 PST — core loop 60m, async system design take-home to follow. Volunteers: Yusuf, Ava, and hiring mgr TBD.
Liam Park: Good. Also add a short candidate checklist in the invite: `-- confirm TFN & LOA done -- test VPN 20m prior -- join orientation 30m before interview for benefits Q&A (optional) -- device pickup at Sydney office 09:00-09:15 AEST`
Yusuf: Courier label created TRACK-AU-778811. Customs doc attached to SHIPMENT-INT-2026-44. Sydney office confirmed hold at front desk under "Redwood Ops - Mei Chen".
Sofia Ramos: I'll run the orientation and record if consent is present. Harper, include consent checkbox in calendar invite and separate recording consent form link.
PeopleOps Bot: Note: payroll onboarding requires bank details & tax form; candidate must upload via secure portal prior to first day. Link: https://redwood/internal/payroll-onboard.
Harper (Recruiter): Invite sent: orientation Thu 2026-12-10 08:30 AEST (15m benefits + 15m payroll). Candidate replied: "Happy with 08:30 orientation — recording is ok." :white_check_mark:
Liam Park: Final: loaner hold confirmed, orientation consent received, panel set. Post-interview: collect candidate orientation survey. Thanks everyone.
